title_zh: 决定先联系捐赠者再处理外套与照片

scenario.label_zh: 决定先联系捐赠者再处理外套与照片
scenario.goal_zh: 检查捐赠外套时发现附有纪念说明的照片，并决定保留标签、先联系捐赠者再处理

context_zh: 社区志愿者整理捐赠衣物，在有破损的外套中发现一张照片。
author: author-phase09-b

sentences.speaker: Faye
sentences.text: There's a hole in this coat. I can put my thumb right through it. Should it go in the recycling pile?

sentences.speaker: Imran
sentences.text: Not yet. Read the tag: 'Please contact me before recycling.' There's a phone number underneath.

sentences.speaker: Faye
sentences.text: And there's a photograph tucked into the pocket. It's caught on the lining.

sentences.speaker: Imran
sentences.text: Don't tear it while you're pulling it out. Let's leave it there for now.

sentences.speaker: Faye
sentences.text: I can read the note on the back: 'Dad's last picture'. This may be a real treasure to the person who donated the coat.

sentences.speaker: Imran
sentences.text: Then we should ask them about both the photograph and the coat before doing anything else.

sentences.speaker: Faye
sentences.text: Agreed. I'll put the whole coat in the hold box with the tag still attached, and call the donor.

sentences.speaker: Imran
sentences.text: Thanks. We won't send it for recycling until we've spoken to them.
